trials.description: A person walking, with a head, body, and legs trailing.
A tall, thin cross with a small base.
A blocky letter P with a long tail and a wide bottom line.
A blocky E shape with a long stem, a horizontal line, and a small head.
A large, blocky T-shape with a gap in the middle of its vertical bar, and a long tail extending from the right side.
A stylized Christmas tree or a downward pointing arrow, with a distinct top point, then widening, then narrowing, then widening again, and then a final narrow base.
A wide S-shape with a horizontal bar in the middle.
A mushroom cloud, or a hammer with a long handle.
A blocky human figure, facing right, with a distinct head, a wide body, and two long, separated legs.
A tall, thin pole with a complex, branching top section that widens then narrows, then a single column of hash marks extending down.
A blocky letter P. It has a distinct upper left section, then a vertical bar that extends down to a wide horizontal base, and a small protrusion on the lower left.
A blocky E, with a wide, solid base, a long vertical stem, and a small, narrow top part that's offset to the right. It has a diagonal element in its middle section.

A large, blocky T-shape, with a wide horizontal top bar and a vertical bar that has a clear gap in its upper section, and a long, thin tail extending downwards from the right side of the vertical bar.
A wide S-shape with a horizontal bar in the middle.
A stylized Christmas tree with a pointed top, widening and narrowing several times, and a distinct base.
A shape with a wide, solid, somewhat triangular top section that narrows, then a long, straight, single-column handle underneath.
A zigzagging shape with a prominent horizontal bar in the middle, and a single hash mark at the very top and bottom.
A shape with a single point at the top, widening and narrowing in distinct layers, with a final two-block base.
A tall, thin pole with a complex, branching top section that widens then narrows, then a single column of hash marks extending down.
A blocky human figure facing right, with a head, a wide chest, and three distinct, separated leg-like sections extending to the right and downwards.
A large, blocky T-shape with a wide, segmented top bar that has a gap on the right, and a long, thin vertical bar extending downwards from the right side of the top bar.
A blocky E with a solid, wide base, a long vertical stem, a small top bar, and a diagonal line in the middle.
A shape with a wide, irregular top section that starts narrow, widens, then narrows, above a long, straight, single-column stem.
A blocky letter P with a distinct, irregular top-left section, a vertical stem, and a very wide, solid horizontal base at the bottom, with a smaller protrusion extending from the bottom left.
A wide horizontal bar on top, followed by two rows of three hashes and a single hash each, and then a long, thin vertical tail of four hashes.
A blocky letter P. It has an irregular top-left section, a vertical stem, and a very wide, solid horizontal base, with a smaller, distinct protrusion from the bottom left of the base.
A shape with a wide, irregular top section that starts narrow, widens, then narrows, above a long, straight, single-column stem, which is offset to the right.
A blocky E shape with a short, two-block top bar, a long vertical left stem, a wide, solid base, and two separated blocks at the very bottom. It has several detached blocks in its middle section.
A tall, thin pole with a complex, branching top section that widens then narrows, then a single column of hash marks extending down. The topmost hash is centered.
A wide S-shape with a horizontal bar in the middle.
A shape with a single point at the top, followed by two rows of three hashes, then a row of two hashes, then a row of four hashes, then two hashes with a gap, and finally a base of two hashes.

A blocky figure with a head (one block), a two-block neck, a main body (four blocks wide), and three distinct, separated leg-like sections extending downwards and to the right, with the lowest leg section being a single block on the far right.
A tall, thin shape with a complex top: a single hash, then two, then a gap, then three. Below this, a single hash on the left, then a column of five hashes shifted one column to the right.

A shape with a single hash at the very top, followed by another single hash slightly to its right. It has a prominent, wide horizontal bar in the middle, below which are a few smaller blocks, a split bar, and then a final single hash at the very bottom right.

A blocky E shape. It has a short top bar on the left, a long vertical stem, a wide solid base, and a small, distinct, separated block on the bottom right. It also has two separated blocks in its middle section.

A wide horizontal bar across the top. Below it, two rows of three hashes, each with a single hash to its right. Then, a long, thin vertical column of four hashes extending downwards from the right side.

A shape with a wide, solid, somewhat triangular top section that narrows, then a long, straight, single-column handle underneath. The top starts with a single block, then shifts right, then widens, then narrows to two blocks. The handle is four blocks tall.

A blocky letter P. It has an irregular top-left section of two rows. Below this is a vertical stem that is offset to the left and contains a small internal gap. It has a very wide, solid horizontal base, with a smaller, distinct two-block protrusion from the bottom left of the base.

A shape that starts with a single point at the top, then widens to two rows of three hashes, then narrows to two hashes, then widens again to four hashes, then two hashes with a gap, and finally a base of two hashes.

A blocky, irregular shape that starts narrow at the top, widens, then narrows to a vertical line with a gap, then widens to four blocks, then has a complex, scattered base of three distinct sections, with the lowest section being a single block on the far right.

A blocky E-shape. It has a top formed by two hashes side by side. A long, vertical stem on the left side, which is interrupted by a single hash at row 6, and a two-hash diagonal element at row 7. Its base is a wide, solid line of seven hashes. Below the base, there are two separated hashes, one on the far left and one on the far right.

A wide horizontal bar of seven hashes at the top. Below it, two identical rows, each with three hashes on the left, then a single hash. From the rightmost single hash, a long, thin vertical tail of four hashes extends downwards.

A shape with a single hash at the very top, followed by another single hash slightly to its right. It has a prominent, wide horizontal bar of six hashes as its third row. Below this, it narrows to three hashes, then two, then a single hash. Then it has a split bar of two hashes, followed by two hashes, then a single hash, and finally a single hash at the very bottom right.
A tall, thin pole with a complex, branching top section that widens then narrows, then a single column of hash marks extending down.

A shape with a wide, irregular top section that starts with a single hash, then shifts right, widens to two hashes, then four, then narrows to two hashes. Below this top section is a long, straight, single-column handle of four hashes.

A shape with a single point at the top, followed by two rows of three hashes, then a row of two hashes. Below this is a wider row of four hashes, then two hashes with a gap, and finally a solid base of two hashes.

A blocky letter P. It has a distinct, irregular top-left section. Its vertical stem is broken and has an internal gap. It has a very wide, solid horizontal base, with a smaller, distinct two-block protrusion from the bottom left of the base.

A blocky human figure. It has a single block head, a two-block neck, a wide four-block body, and three distinct, scattered leg sections extending downwards and to the right, with the lowest leg being a single block on the far right.
A blocky human-like figure, leaning right, with a small head, a wide body, and three distinct, scattered leg sections that extend to the right.

A wide, solid horizontal bar on top. Below it are two rows, each with three hashes on the left and a single hash on the right. From the rightmost single hash, a long, thin vertical tail of four hashes extends downwards.
A blocky letter P. It has an irregular top-left section, a broken vertical stem, and a very wide, solid horizontal base with a distinct two-block protrusion from its bottom-left side.

A tall, thin shape. Its top section is complex: a single hash, then two, then two with a gap, then three solid hashes. Below this, a single hash on the far left, followed by a long, straight column of five hashes, shifted right.

A shape with a wide, irregular top section that starts with a single hash, then shifts right, widens to two hashes, then four, then narrows to two hashes. Below this top section is a long, straight, single-column handle of four hashes.

A blocky E-shape. It has a short top bar of two hashes. A long, vertical stem on the left side, which is broken by a single hash at row 6, and a diagonal element at row 7. Its base is a wide, solid line of seven hashes. Below the base, there are two separated hashes, one on the far left and one on the far right.

A shape that starts with a single point at the top, then widens to two rows of three hashes, then narrows to two hashes, then widens again to four hashes. Below this, there are two hashes with a gap, and finally a solid base of two hashes.

A shape with a single hash at the very top, followed by another single hash slightly to its right. It has a prominent, wide horizontal bar in the middle. Below this, it narrows, then widens to a split bar, then narrows again, ending with a single hash at the very bottom right.

A blocky E-shape. It has a short top bar of two hashes. A long, vertical stem on the left side, which is broken by a single hash at row 6, and a diagonal element at row 7. Its base is a wide, solid line of seven hashes. Below the base, there are two separated hashes, one on the far left and one on the far right.
A blocky letter P. It has an irregular top-left section, a broken vertical stem, and a very wide, solid horizontal base with a distinct two-block protrusion from its bottom-left side.

A tall, thin shape. Its top section starts with a single hash, then two, then a single hash with a gap to its left, then three solid hashes. Below this, there's a single hash on the far left, followed by a long, straight column of five hashes, which is shifted one column to the right of the single hash above it.

A blocky, irregular shape. It has a single hash head, a two-hash neck. Its body is three rows of split hashes, then a solid four-hash bar. Below this, it has three distinct, scattered sections that trail downwards and to the right, ending with a single hash at the far bottom right.

A wide horizontal bar of seven hashes at the top. Below it, two identical rows, each containing three hashes on the left and a single hash on the right. From the rightmost single hash, a distinct, long, thin vertical tail of four hashes extends downwards.

A shape with a wide, irregular top section that starts with a single hash, shifts right, widens to two, then four, then narrows to two hashes. Below this, a long, straight, single-column handle of four hashes.
A shape with a single point at the top, widening to three hashes, then narrowing, then widening again to four hashes, and ending with a base of two hashes.

A shape with a single hash at the very top, followed by another single hash slightly to its right. It has a prominent, wide horizontal bar in the middle. Below this, it narrows, then widens to a split bar, then narrows again, ending with a single hash at the very bottom right.
